newsitem.title: GERMANY: Breuer happy with Deutsche share price.
newsitem.headline: Breuer happy with Deutsche share price.

text.p: Future Deutsche Bank AG chief executive Rolf Breuer said on Wednesday evening he was happy with the bank's share price.
Speaking to Reuters after delivering an address to a banking audience in Frankfurt on Wednesday evening, Breuer said: "I am satisfied with our performance."
However he added that the upside potential for the German share market overall was getting narrower.
Deutsche shares, which have performed strongly in recent weeks, closed bourse trade on Wednesday down 17 pfennigs at 88.18 marks.
